title: Periodic words, common subsequences and frogs
venue: Annals of Applied Probability, Vol. 32, No. 2
key_contribution: Introduces frog dynamics for LCS of periodic-vs-random words; provides exact formulas for γ(W) when W has distinct symbols; relates to PushTASEP

title: Frogs, hats and common subsequences
key_contribution: Extends frog dynamics analysis to palindromic words W = 12...kk...21; analyzes PushTASEP on ring with correlated clocks; introduces 'frogs with hats'

title: TASEP hydrodynamics using microscopic characteristics
key_contribution: Self-contained treatment of TASEP convergence to Burgers equation using second-class particles; provides tools applicable to LCS particle systems
